Summary and context:

Use-case / requirements (from discovery call):
- Workload: high-concurrency, latency-sensitive ranking + small chat overlays for call-center agents.
- Targets: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 65ms for 512-token sequences (primary), sustained throughput 200-300 QPS during peak campaigns, burst to 800 QPS.
- Cost sensitivity: constrained — wants to reduce per-request token cost vs current self-hosted PyTorch endpoints (target 40% unit cost reduction).
- Model preferences: open models (Llama3 family variants) with quantized variants accepted; want to test int8 + 4-bit QAT if quality is acceptable.
- Routing/fallback: primary low-latency region (us-east) with fallback to cheaper batch variants during night windows; need automatic fallback without user-visible errors.
- Caching needs: session KV/PREFIX cache for repeated user context, and prefix coalescing across similar sessions to reduce tokens.
- Batching policy: workload has many short (20-80 token) requests; interested in micro-batching w/ dynamic batching but strict tail-latency SLO.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, and regression alerts tied to prompt sets.
